summary.prose: Building this Story is a small, coordinated fix across three codebases: one bash function (scripts/daemon-ctl.sh's cmd_update) stops forcing an unmanaged install through a signing gate it can never pass, matching the plain fallback its sibling verbs already use; then both IDE plugins (VS Code's controller.ts, JetBrains's ScriptDaemonProvisioner.kt) drop their own now-redundant pre-emptive detection of the same case, since the shared script now safely routes either way on its own. Five existing tests are rewritten to match, including the authoritative cross-client integration test that currently codifies the broken behavior as correct.

tasks.title: Fix scripts/daemon-ctl.sh's cmd_update: drop the Darwin+unmanaged re-exec into the signed installer bridge
tasks.summary: Remove the Darwin-specific re-exec into insrc-daemon-install.sh in cmd_update's unmanaged (supervised_lifecycle rc=10) branch; let it fall through to the existing plain sync_repo/npm_install_if_needed/npm_build sequence already used on non-Darwin, matching cmd_start/cmd_stop/cmd_restart's existing unmanaged behavior. The managed branch (rc=0) is untouched.
acceptanceChecks: An unmanaged install's `daemon-ctl.sh update` on Darwin completes via git fetch + npm install + npm build with no signing requirement and no call into insrc-daemon-install.sh.
A managed install's `daemon-ctl.sh update` behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/macos-upgrade-routing.test.ts: 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix' (rewritten)

tasks.title: Simplify vscode-plugin's createDaemonLifecycleController.run('update'): drop the install(true) pre-emption
tasks.summary: Remove run('update')'s special-case that detects an unmanaged-but-present install and calls install(true) (spawning the bundled signed installer). run('update') always spawns the resolved daemon-ctl.sh with 'update', delegating the managed/unmanaged decision to the now-fixed script from t1.
acceptanceChecks: run('update') on an unmanaged install always spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update', never the bundled installer.
run('update') on a managed install is unchanged.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/daemon/__tests__/controller.test.ts: 'The VS Code update action selects the installer on legacy macOS and the selected controller after migration' (replaced with an assertion that update always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update, unmanaged or managed)

tasks.title: Simplify jetbrains-plugin's ScriptDaemonProvisioner.run(UPDATE): remove the legacy/existingUpgradeTarget() branch
tasks.summary: Remove run(kind)'s legacy branch for UPDATE (computed from locator.existingUpgradeTarget()) so UPDATE always resolves via locator.scriptFor(UPDATE) and spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update'. Remove the now-dead DaemonLifecycleService.existingUpgradeTarget() override and the DaemonScriptLocator interface's existingUpgradeTarget() default, since nothing calls it anymore.
acceptanceChecks: ScriptDaemonProvisioner.run(ProvisionKind.UPDATE, ...) on an unmanaged install always spawns 'bash <daemon-ctl.sh> update', never the bundled installer with --target.

tasks.title: Rewrite vscode-plugin's controller.test.ts to assert the corrected update routing
tasks.summary: Replace 'The VS Code update action selects the installer on legacy macOS and the selected controller after migration' with an assertion that run('update') always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update for both the unmanaged and the managed case, matching t2's new behavior.
acceptanceChecks: The rewritten test passes against t2's implementation and fails if the install(true) pre-emption is reintroduced.

tasks.title: Rewrite jetbrains-plugin's three affected test files to assert the corrected update routing
tasks.summary: Rewrite DaemonProvisionerTest.kt, DefaultDaemonScriptLocatorTest.kt and DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest.kt so none of them exercise the removed legacy/existingUpgradeTarget() branch; each asserts UPDATE always spawns daemon-ctl.sh update for an unmanaged install, matching t3's new behavior, with INSTALL coverage unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: All three rewritten test files pass against t3's implementation and fail if the legacy branch or existingUpgradeTarget() is reintroduced.

tasks.title: Rewrite the cross-client integration test 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix'
tasks.summary: Rewrite src/daemon/__tests__/macos-upgrade-routing.test.ts so its unmanaged-checkout assertions expect a plain git-fetch+npm-install+npm-build sequence (no authorize/npm ci/npm run/prepare-legacy-upgrade trace events) across all four surfaces (raw installer, daemon-ctl.sh update, vscode-plugin's run('update'), jetbrains-plugin's DaemonLifecycleCommandRunnerTest bridge), while adding a second fixture for a genuinely managed checkout whose assertions are left exactly as the test's current managed-path behavior.
acceptanceChecks: The rewritten test's unmanaged-fixture assertions show no authorize/npm-ci/npm-run/prepare-legacy-upgrade trace events across all four surfaces, and all four complete successfully.
The rewritten test's new managed-fixture assertions show the signed bridge still engaging for all four surfaces, unchanged from today.
